$comment: Provider presets for the interactive picker (tui.mjs provider-picker flow) and the --provider CLI flag. Each preset is a complete {primary, tiers} map. Selecting a preset writes ~/.config/opencode/models.json from the chosen entry. Local presets (local-llm/vllm) map all tiers to the single locally-loaded model. Edit model IDs here as providers release newer versions.

zai-custom.$comment: User-owned copy of zai-coding-plan declared via provider.zai-custom in opencode.json (same Z.AI coding endpoint) so OpenWork and other OpenCode-config consumers can see GLM models without the built-in provider.
zai-custom.label: Z.AI Coding Plan (Custom)

openrouter.$comment: OpenRouter is a router - picker prompts for a model string per tier. This entry is a template; tui.mjs expands it by prompting.
openrouter.label: OpenRouter (custom per tier)

ollama.$comment: Same standardized @ai-sdk/openai-compatible entry as local-llm/vllm - any OpenAI-compatible server (LM Studio, llama.cpp box, etc.) can reuse this pattern by changing baseURL. Model IDs must match the serving host (ollama list).
ollama.label: Local LLM (Ollama, qwen3-coder a3b)
